entries.what: Bare toes stick out through the front of his right sneaker, so the foot is both bare and shod.
In the eye close-up his two irises are different colours, pink in the left eye and amber in the right, with heavy feminine lashes.
The clasped hands in the centre are a knot of fused, melting fingers that do not resolve into two hands.
The hand holding the red kerchief is a boneless blob with no distinct fingers and an odd lace frill at the wrist.
The pointing Indio cutout has much darker orange skin and a flatter older cel style than Indio in the rest of the episode.
Faint letter-like scribbles sit on the gold ring in the intro frame.
Letter-like marks are printed around the rim of the soup pot.
Five hands reach for the bread although only two people are in the shot.
entries.where: four hands around the bread plus one more at the top right

entries.what: Two arms grow from his right shoulder: one points at the fox while a second hangs down with a kerchief at its wrist.
His nose is drawn as a black animal nose pad and the open mouth is a row of pointed fangs, so the face reads as a dog muzzle on a man.
The pointing hand is a smooth mitten with one finger and no thumb or other fingers.
The hand over the lamp has its fingers fused into one lump and the hand under it shows two thumb-shaped digits and no fingers.
entries.where: both hands on the lamp, centre

entries.what: The hand over the page has no drawn fingertips; its fingers melt into the paper and the lower hand's fingers blend into the page edge.
entries.where: both hands on the notebook, left

entries.what: The glowing spirit hand on his head is three finger-tubes with no palm and no thumb.
His left hand is a boneless paddle whose fingers are brown lumps rather than drawn fingers.
Indio's forearm disappears into M's coat cuff, so his kerchiefed hand looks as if it grows out of her sleeve.
The helicopter's body runs into a boat hull which in turn merges with the red car beside it, one object made of three.
A second red cloth floats in the air behind him attached to nothing, beside the kerchief tied to the bike.

His eyes are steel blue in this tear close-up although they are brown elsewhere, and he wears a red kerchief on both wrists instead of one (the double kerchief also shows in k20, k51, k53, k57 and k64).
M has pale grey eyes and a paler, rounder face here, while in the shots just before and after her eyes are warm brown.
M's hair is brown and her eyes blue-grey here, against black hair and brown eyes in the other M shots.
M wears a dusty rose coat in the cast line-up although her coat is dark in every other shot.
Letter-like scribbles are printed on the label of the bottle beside the hand.
A small watermark-like logo with letter-like marks under an arch sits in the dark bottom-right corner.
